exam.title: Administering Microsoft Azure SQL Solutions
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical SQL Server and Azure SQL administration, T-SQL, relational engine fundamentals, security, performance tuning, automation, backup and restore, migration, and high availability experience.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Plan and implement data platform resources
Monitor, configure, and optimize database resources
Configure and manage automation of tasks
Plan and configure a high availability and disaster recovery (HA/DR) environment

review.notes: All five April 24, 2026 objective groups and every published subobjective are mapped to platform choices, dependency paths, configuration boundaries, evidence, failure actions, three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs and 28 original knowledge checks. All 65 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries: 62 were reachable and three O'Reilly/Udemy pages were access-blocked; no cited page was missing or broken. The guide covers Azure SQL Database, Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs and hybrid SQL, SQL database in Fabric, both Arc SQL models, automated deployment, partitioning/sharding/compression, current migration methods, Entra/SQL authorization, network/encryption/compliance controls, database watcher/Query Store/Extended Events/DMVs, query and resource tuning, Agent/elastic jobs/Azure automation, and platform-specific backup/HA/DR. It explicitly marks Azure Data Studio as retired February 28, 2026 and directs readers to supported current migration/tool experiences. No upcoming blueprint change or retirement was announced on the official pages.

findings.title: Missing Intelligent Insights coverage
findings.evidence: The detailed blueprint includes this separately from watcher and IQP.
findings.recommendation: Add log, baseline, export, regional and corroborating-evidence explanation.
findings.resolution: Add log, baseline, export, regional and corroborating-evidence explanation.

findings.title: Watcher target inventory
findings.evidence: Preview target count includes readable replicas.

findings.title: Weighted runtime aggregation
findings.evidence: Counts, units and active-interval grouping affect interpretation.
findings.recommendation: Add weighted mean and outlier/interval handling example.
findings.resolution: Add weighted mean and outlier/interval handling example.

findings.title: MI migration completion state
findings.evidence: Seeding and manual completion have different consequences; copy is not ongoing replication.
findings.recommendation: Add completion deadline, cancellation, source removal and backup-chain example.
findings.resolution: Add completion deadline, cancellation, source removal and backup-chain example.

findings.title: Enclave support differs by platform
findings.evidence: Ordinary Always Encrypted support is broader than enclave support.
findings.recommendation: Add enclave and attestation matrix for October wording.
findings.resolution: Add enclave and attestation matrix for October wording.

findings.title: Compaction is not all maintenance
findings.evidence: Preview support and background page work have defined boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Add density exercise and keep statistics/integrity tasks separate.
findings.resolution: Add density exercise and keep statistics/integrity tasks separate.

findings.title: Automatic and manual tuning differ
findings.evidence: Automatic index actions and validation differ by platform/application route.
findings.recommendation: Clarify MI plan correction, protected unique indexes and manual T-SQL rollback responsibility.
findings.resolution: Clarify MI plan correction, protected unique indexes and manual T-SQL rollback responsibility.

findings.title: Elastic-job identity and path
findings.evidence: Entra jobs require user-assigned identity; service-managed endpoints require approval.
findings.recommendation: Explain target user, credential enumeration and per-server connectivity verification.
findings.resolution: Explain target user, credential enumeration and per-server connectivity verification.

findings.title: Backup protection is scoped
findings.evidence: Recent PITR immutability excludes some policies/tiers and is separate from retention.
findings.recommendation: Add exclusions and avoid treating all retained days as immutable.
findings.resolution: Add exclusions and avoid treating all retained days as immutable.

findings.title: Feature-level release status
findings.evidence: Entra logins and LTR mechanisms have different GA/preview status.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish logins from server roles and time-based from legal-hold LTR.
findings.resolution: Distinguish logins from server roles and time-based from legal-hold LTR.

findings.title: Expected internal probe failures
findings.evidence: Internal tests deliberately fail authentication; records have a documented signature.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped classification lab without granting the probe user or suppressing all login errors.
findings.resolution: Add scoped classification lab without granting the probe user or suppressing all login errors.

findings.title: Application recovery timing
findings.evidence: Database promotion is one component of recovery.
findings.recommendation: Add 18-minute versus 15-minute RTO example and observation-versus-guarantee RPO distinction.
findings.resolution: Add 18-minute versus 15-minute RTO example and observation-versus-guarantee RPO distinction.
